artifacts.description: Ranked backlog of 6 warehouse-inventory features (RICE), with the F-05.6/F-05.1 dependency-forced reorder and the F-05.6 duplicate-ticket flag documented in full.

content.execution_summary:
• Scored and ranked 6/6 features using RICE; 0 gaps.
• Rank adjustment: F-05.6 moved above F-05.1 (its raw RICE was 2nd-highest) because F-05.6 directly blocks F-05.1, which itself transitively blocks 3 more features — outranking a blocker would have violated the dependency graph.
• F-05.1 kept its high rank (blocks F-05.2, F-05.3, F-05.5 — 3 downstream features, meeting the >=3-blocks uplift rule) but could not pass F-05.6.
• Remaining 4 features ranked by raw RICE score with no further dependency conflicts.
• Reflection: verified rank sequence 1-6, no duplicates, no remaining blocked-by/rank contradictions, no summary field copied full artifact text.
• Knowledge bases consulted: kb-L1-sdlc-templates — used for the prioritized-backlog.md table/rationale layout.
• Guardrails evaluated: gr-L1-output-schema-validator (pass), gr-L1-pii-detection (pass), gr-L3-hallucination-detector (pass), gr-L3-citation-validator (pass), gr-L1-consistency-check (pass), gr-L2-tool-permissions (pass), gr-L3-agent-rate-limit (pass).
• Tools invoked: tool-L1-jira-fetch-issue — checked all 6 feature names against the adjacent backlog; found 1 likely duplicate (F-05.6 vs existing ticket WMS-142).
• Gaps or issues flagged: none.
